children: Read by the watch — not a Shield rule
Rule change · by J. Otieno · Aug 13, 2026
real records touched — nothing in the copy is real, and nothing it read has left it.
It is held on a timer while a person looks. Nothing is permanent, and it releases on its own if nothing else arrives. Everything it does in the copy is evidence; how the copy is built is never shown.
The session stays open while a person looks. It closes when released or ended — with findings or without. Every action and finding is in the copy session.
It touched a record planted as bait. No honest path reaches that record.
This is certain, not suspicion. It reached for something no honest path reaches, and the reach itself is the evidence.
Re-checked on demand — the check re-runs against the same stored evidence.
Anything touching planted bait is stopped at once.
Rule set at founding · version 3 · no waiting period applies to bait.
